items.statement: The investigation records a finite, chemically motivated candidate-generation space, candidate identities, optimization outcomes, deduplication rule, validation outcomes, and an explicit stopping or bounded-failure condition.
items.expected: Candidate-level provenance and coverage are reported, and each advanced claimed minimum has an explicit optimization and stationary-point validation record.

items.statement: Stable structures are distinguished from unvalidated stationary points using vibrational or an equivalently justified stationary-point test.
items.expected: The report identifies imaginary-mode counts or an equivalent test for each advanced candidate and does not count an unvalidated structure as a confirmed minimum.

items.statement: The paper reports that three distinct imidazole–salicylic-acid hydrogen-bond systems were stable.
items.expected: The completed search reports three validated distinct minima, or a transparent partial result that explicitly limits any comparison to the explored space.

items.statement: The source identifies one of the three stable configurations as having the smallest interaction energy and reports that value as −36.59 kJ/mol.
items.expected: The report identifies its strongest validated candidate and gives an interaction-energy comparison; a source-aligned conclusion recognizes the reported −36.59 kJ/mol strongest interaction while distinguishing independent computed values and method dependence.
